copy.text: Tap empty space to add a hole. Choose a hole to move or remove it.
Undo returns one mask edit. Inspecting the sky does not change the mask.
Move the average opening to the middle. Gaps stay the same, so the brightness stays the same; the arriving arrows may turn. Undo returns the whole mask.
These changes keep the holes together as a shape, but change their gaps or direction. The bright stripes change with them.
Keep the openings, not the inspected spot. Returning changes the mask once; Undo brings your experiment back.

The centers keep their gaps. Identical rectangular source patches add a broad envelope around the interference. The origin keeps the same normalized brightness; this is not a measurement of transmitted light. Overlapping patches add their fields, not a merged cutout.

The openings have not moved. Opposite phases put every second source half a turn behind its neighbor. Quarter-turn leads advance each source by a quarter turn in mask order. Change the start of the waves, not their color.
Close the other sources without removing them. One opening alone stays on the complete mask’s brightness scale. Choose another hole to see its part of the same sum.
The slice crosses the inspected spot in the chosen direction. It shows raw intensity; the sky brightens dim light for display.
Blue is the current mask; dashed gold is the kept mask at this row. Both use the current illumination and the same intensity scale.

cases.title: Holes & Stars — Keep translation and gap changes in different doors
cases.goal: A whole-mask translation can be inspected without confusing it with an edit to the gaps. Its explanation accompanies the four move buttons.
cases.steps: Wrap the intact .translation div in closed details #mask-translation in its existing source-column location. Preserve its translation-heading and both paragraphs/controls. Include692 #mask-origin-selected and its help in this translation door, moving from whichever geometry wrapper692 used if necessary: choosing an origin is also a whole-mask translation. Keep mask-geometry a separate sibling, never a child. Keep selected-hole x/y sliders, add/remove gesture, Undo/Redo and mask-history-help outside. No model/handler changes and no extra rendering on disclosure. Scoped CSS must preserve the original source column.

groups.summary: Move the whole mask, keep the gaps

cases.message: whole-mask translation and gap changes use independent doors without changing the mask

cases.title: Holes & Stars — Keep the four-opening experiments beside their explanation
cases.goal: Pair/Triangle/Ring stay quick starting shapes. The three four-opening comparisons form one optional experiment with its own words.
cases.steps: Inside existing .presets keep Pair/Triangle/Ring buttons outside. Add closed details #mask-array-experiments after them and move the three684 buttons data-preset row/broken/square plus #array-presets-help into it, preserving all labels/text. Ensure this details takes the full preset-group width rather than one narrow grid cell. Do not change or recreate preset arrays, count normalization, illumination or selection. Native summary only; no automatic preset selection on disclosure.
cases.message: four-opening experiments share a quiet shelf while the three starting shapes stay direct
